meta.name: version-bump
meta.description: Automated semantic versioning and release workflow for Claude Code plugins. Handles version increments across package.json, marketplace.json, plugin.json manifests, build verification, git tagging, GitHub releases, and changelog generation. NPM publishing is the final human-required handoff because the maintainer raised npm security.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动完成版本号递增、构建校验、git 标签与发布说明生成
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次发版都要手动改版本号、打标签、写发布说明。
copy.tagline_en: Automate version bumps, build checks, git tags, and changelog generation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if every release means manually editing versions, tagging, and writing release notes.

howto.what: 它会自动完成版本升级与发布流程：更新八处版本号、运行构建同步、提交并推送代码和标签、创建GitHub Release、重新生成变更日志，最后只把npm发布留给你执行。
howto.when: 当你要求为Claude Code插件做版本升级、发布新版本或打tag发GitHub Release时触发。

say.text: 帮我发布v1.2.3，这是修复bug的补丁版本。
say.note: 它会按PATCH更新版本并走完整发布流程。

say.text: 升级到下一个MINOR版本并重新生成变更日志。
只做发布准备，不要执行npm publish。
say.note: 它会把所有准备做完后停下，把npm publish留给你。

howto.what_en: It automates the release workflow: bumps all eight version strings, runs build-and-sync, commits and pushes code and tags, creates a GitHub Release, regenerates the changelog, and leaves the final npm publish for the human to run.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to bump a version, publish a release, or tag and create a GitHub Release for a Claude Code plugin.

say_en.text: Help me release v1.2.3 as a bugfix patch version.
say_en.note: It bumps PATCH and runs the full release workflow.

say_en.text: Bump to the next MINOR version and regenerate the changelog.
say_en.note: Trigger the version bump and CHANGELOG rewrite.

say_en.text: Prepare the release only and do not run npm publish.
say_en.note: It stops after all prep and leaves npm publish to you.
